text:
$BTC slipped 0.5% to $83,814, bounced up to $84,564 before settling near the low of $82,900. $ETH fell 1.4% to $2,695, hitting a high of $2,744 and a low of $2,657. $BNB nudged up 0.4% to $768, trading between $750 and $771 with solid volume.

Watch the $BTC 84.5K-85K range; a break either way could set the tone for the next session.

$ETH is nudging up against $BTC, +0.25% in the 24-hr window. Meanwhile $BTC posted a +0.484% move, but the average alt in the top-20 basket jumped +4.98%, easily outpacing the king. So $BTC's still ahead of the broader market, yet $ETH is gaining a tiny edge on its own. Overall it's a modest alt rally with $ETH tightening its grip on $BTC. Nothing wild, just a quiet shift in relative strength.

$AVAX jumped around a lot, its 24-hour swing hit 14.76 % while it usually sits near 7.67 %, that's more than double its normal range.

$ETH was almost flat; it moved about 3.59 % today versus a typical 3.02 % range, barely a change.

Overall, AVAX was the only token that really broke its usual band. Nothing crazy elsewhere.

$BTC slipped 1.07% to $83,116, trading between $84,564 high and $82,776 low, volume about 13.6k. $ETH fell 1.21% to $2,675, its range $2,749-$2,652 with 310k trades. $BNB dropped 2.28% to $752.6, barely nudged above $752.2, peaked at $771, volume 122.6k.

Watch the $BTC-$ETH spread; any widening could hint at risk-off pressure creeping in.

$BTC bounced to $84,318, up 1.11% in 24h, peaked at $84,500 before slipping to a low of $82,563. Volume hit ~15.3k BTC, $1.28 bn in quote terms.

$ETH jumped to $2,738.94, +2.16% with a high of $2,748.6 and a floor around $2,651.68. Heavy flow: ~307.6k ETH traded, $829.9 m quoted.

$BNB eased to $765.68, down 0.38%; it hovered between $753.81 and $773.45. Trade count stayed solid at ~130.8k, $99.8 m in quote volume.

BTC's range widened, ETH kept climbing, BNB's edge trimmed. Keep an eye on whether $BTC can hold above $84k and if $ETH stays near the $2.74k zone; $BNB's next move will likely follow the same tight band.

$ETH is pulling a little ahead of $BTC, up 0.754% against it while $BTC slipped 0.645% in USD terms. The 20-coin basket fell 2.274%, so $BTC's decline was far milder than the average alt. In short, ETH's relative strength is rising, but $BTC still beat the broader pack. Nothing wild, just a modest reshuffle.

$ETH is pulling a little ahead of $BTC, up 1.26% in the BTC-denominated pair while $BTC slipped 1.54% in USD. The 20-coin basket averaged a 1.54% drop, basically matching $BTC's loss. So $ETH's relative strength is the only bright spot; everything else in the most-traded alt set is lagging behind the king. Nothing wild, just $ETH gaining ground as $BTC and the rest of the basket tumble. Looks like a quiet pull-back across the board.

$QNT surged 26.2% and ripped through an 82.1% 24-hour range, that's more than three times its usual swing. $HBAR jumped 36.9% and covered a 27.6% range, roughly 3.5 × its normal volatility. $UNI slipped 7.8% but only widened to a 13.2% range, barely above its typical 10.6%, basically a regular day. All three moved hard, but $QNT and $HBAR were the real outliers. Nothing else crazy on the board.
